NSPanel HAUI 0.4.2 completes the update path. The panel can now install its own
firmware update, a release no longer needs a Nextion Editor visit just to change
the version, and the TFT reinstall loop and buzzer bugs reported by users are
fixed.

### Highlights

- **Firmware auto-update** — every release now ships a `firmware-manifest.json`
  and the firmware exposes an **HAUI Firmware** update entity. When a newer
  release exists and `firmware_auto_update` is on (the default), the hub asks
  Home Assistant to install the device's firmware first; the matching TFT
  follows after the reboot. A running TFT upload is never interrupted — the
  firmware install waits for it to finish. Set `firmware_auto_update: false` to
  keep the previous notice-only behaviour.
- **Version bump tooling** — `scripts/bump_version.py` updates the manifest,
  `pyproject.toml`, ESPHome `version.yaml` and both HMI `system.tftVersion`
  values in one command. `--check` is a dry run and the script is covered by
  `tests/test_bump_version.py`. A same-length version no longer needs the
  Nextion Editor.
- **CI guardrails** — the tests workflow checks version consistency and
  translation freshness; the release workflow rejects a tag whose version
  disagrees with `manifest.json`, so a release cannot ship a mismatched version.
- **TFT reinstall loop fixed (#63)** — an empty `tft_version` in the boot
  handshake is treated as unknown instead of `0.0.0`, so the hub no longer
  reinstalls the TFT after every reboot. A recent unconfirmed install is not
  auto-retried; use **Install TFT** in the editor to retry.
- **Buzzer stops for TFT uploads (#62)** — a playing tune is stopped before the
  upload starts instead of sounding until the reboot.
- **Portrait weather time and date centred (#64)** — the portrait `tTime`/`tDate`
  widgets now centre instead of drawing against the screen edge.
- **Clearer install failures** — failed TFT installs return HTTP 502 and show a
  toast in the editor; a GitHub API failure during the update check no longer
  raises out of the timer callback.
- **Vendored Nextion fix** — released ESPHome builds lack the numeric-response
  delivery fix, so the firmware ships the patched 2026.10.0 component. Display
  reads (`page`, `dim`, `res_val`, `res_txt`, TFT version) work on released
  ESPHome; recompile and flash the firmware once.

### Before you update

> **The ESPHome web server is no longer enabled by default.** The shipped
> firmware leaves out `web_server` to free flash and RAM for the HTTP OTA path.
> The device's web UI on port 80 and Home Assistant's **Visit** link disappear
> after flashing. Add a `web_server:` block to your own device YAML to keep it —
> see [docs/esphome.md](docs/esphome.md#web-server-optional).

> **Flash the new firmware once manually.** The **HAUI Firmware** entity only
> exists from 0.4.2 on, so an older firmware cannot be updated by the hub. After
> that first flash, later firmware updates can come through Home Assistant.

> **The release's TFTs already contain the display fixes.** A TFT auto-update
> installs them; rebuilding the TFTs from the HMI yourself is only needed if you
> maintain a custom build.

  sounding through a TFT upload. Thanks to [@jsenecal](https://github.com/jsenecal).
- [#63](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/63) — TFT reinstalls
  after every panel reboot. Thanks to [@jsenecal](https://github.com/jsenecal).
- [#64](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/64) — portrait weather
  time and date are right-aligned. Thanks to [@jsenecal](https://github.com/jsenecal).
